findings.text: The report has no safety, red-team, jailbreak, honesty, bias, or dangerous-capability section; evaluations are code, math-via-code, and general language capability only.

source.quote:
We have carried out comprehensive experiments using a variety of public code-related
benchmarks.

notes: Technical report on DeepSeek-Coder (arXiv 2401.14196). No safety/alignment risk section. Instruction tuning uses 'helpful and impartial' data (training method only; not topic coverage). Covers Instruct seed ids for 1.3B/6.7B/33B and 7B Instruct v1.5; Base variants are named and evaluated and are seed checkpoints. Skipped capability benches: HumanEval (incl. multilingual), MBPP, DS-1000, LeetCode Contest, FIM/code completion, CrossCodeEval / cross-file completion, program-aided math (GSM8K, MATH, GSM-Hard, SVAMP, TabMWP, ASDiv, MAWPS), MMLU, BBH, HellaSwag, Winogrande, ARC-Challenge. One typo in text: 'Instruct 34B' for the 33B model.
